verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes first-party task pages written in plain language for founder tasks. The EIN page explains how to apply online, operating hours, the one-EIN-per-day limit, the 15-minute timeout ('you'll need to start over'), the third-party designee option, and the mail/fax fallback. The Pub 525 update tells taxpayers in plain words how to make the 83(b) election. Beyond those two tasks, the evidence shows only page titles, and even the 83(b) guidance largely points to Form 15620 rather than walking through steps. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step walkthroughs for founder tasks, guidance coverage beyond EIN and 83(b), and independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow it.
